title: 阿兹尔·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 修长金色鸟喙呼应高窄冠饰，金甲与红布组成帝王装束。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Azir is a regal avian ascended emperor with a long golden beak, tall narrow crown, bright eyes, and layered gold armor over deep red cloth. Preserve his bird head, dignified upright torso, and fully covered limbs beneath an opaque full-length robe and boots. His long imperial staff is planted vertically at his side as a ceremonial support, without commanding soldiers or attacking.
art_direction.scene: A composed near-profile study with a gentle head turn, signature forms stacked into a tall diagonal, luminous rim and airy negative space. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: sun gold, oxblood red, sandstone, indigo shadow; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
